archetypes.name: secret-counts
archetypes.rationale: Run-log scrub-count plumbing crosses design publish and commit paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the run-log scrub-count flow from design publish copy through run-log commit output. Check that the same scrubbed bytes are counted and written, and that same-tree design publishes do not double-count. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: continuation-warnings
archetypes.rationale: Step 3 warning carry must avoid stale state while surviving continuation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan-review continuation changes. Verify only DEGRADED_PANEL_WARNING and INVALID_SLOT_PANEL_WARNING carry across rounds, and stale accepted-count or tally state cannot leak into final envelopes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: prune-tokenizer
archetypes.rationale: Plan-mode reviewer tokenization must support both spaced labels and whitespace-separated labels.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan-mode reviewer tokenizer and prune ledger coverage. Check longest-label matching, comma handling, and preservation of labels containing internal spaces such as dynamic reviewer names. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
